heading:
Everyday creative work
shouldn’t be this hard.
lead: Most people don’t want a design studio. They want one correct file, now - without breaking the brand, without waiting on someone and without being asked to sign up and pay before they can start. Lolly exists to take those three frustrations away.

frustrations.title: Off-brand anxiety
frustrations.desc: The quiet dread of picking the wrong colour or font and getting it wrong in public.

frustrations.title: The bottleneck
frustrations.desc: Every small asset stuck in a queue behind a busy designer, a slow tool or one more approval.

frustrations.title: The toll gate
frustrations.desc: An account before you can start, a subscription that outlives the job and one more charge at the moment you try to download.

matrix.pain: Sign in before you are allowed to make anything.
matrix.relief: Open it and start. There is no account.

matrix.pain: Your work lives where you don't get a vote: the rules can change, and you find out later.
matrix.relief: Your work stays with you. Every choice about it is yours, and you can see each one.

matrix.pain: A subscription that keeps charging long after the job is done.
matrix.relief: Free, and it stays free: a version that has been released can never be taken back.

matrix.pain: The template that is almost right, but the part you need is locked behind an upgrade.
matrix.relief: What should change is yours to change; what should not is already handled.

matrix.pain: Finish the design, then find the download costs extra.
matrix.relief: Every export is included: print-quality PDF, sharp SVG, video, all of it.

matrix.pain: Pay the AI again for something it already made, and get it back slightly different.
matrix.relief: AI is optional, and it answers to you. What you make is identical where you want it, different how you want it - and re-making it is free.

matrix.pain: Email a brief to the design team, then wait days for one small graphic.
matrix.relief: Fill in a few fields. The finished file is ready in seconds.

matrix.pain: Guess at the right font, colour and logo - and hope it passes brand review.
matrix.relief: The design rules are baked into the tool. They bend, not break.

matrix.pain: Re-make the same badge, card or banner a hundred times by hand.
matrix.relief: Paste a spreadsheet. Get a hundred finished, print-ready files at once.

matrix.pain: “Which version is the latest?” - hunting through Slack threads and shared drives.
matrix.relief: The file is a link. Same inputs, same file, every single time.
